newsitem.title: JAPAN: Citizen Watch 1st half profit seen up 32 pct-paper.
newsitem.headline: Citizen Watch 1st half profit seen up 32 pct-paper.

text.p: Citizen Watch Co Ltd's parent current profit in the six months to September 30, 1996, is expected to show a year-on-year rise of 32 percent to about 5.5 billion yen, a Japanese business daily said on Tuesday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Citizen's full-year parent current profit is expected to rise to about 10.5 billion yen, surpassing the 10 billion level for the first time in three years. Its actual parent current profit in 1995/96 was 8.93 billion yen.
The expected rise is due to bigger revenues in its watch division and an increase in profit in its information equipment division, the paper said.
A Citizen spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
